description: This file implements a vector of instance-based selectors for permission management, including functions for initialization, destruction, adding, removing, and querying permission selectors based on instance numbers. It also contains logic for matching instances against selectors to determine permissions.

methods.name: void INST_SEL_VECTOR_Init(inst_sel_vector_t * isv)
methods.description: Initializes a permission instance vector structure by setting its internal pointer to NULL and count to zero.

methods.name: void INST_SEL_VECTOR_Destroy(inst_sel_vector_t * isv,bool destroy_entries)
methods.description: Deinitializes the vector, optionally freeing individual entries if owned, and resets the structure to an empty state.

methods.name: void INST_SEL_VECTOR_Unwatch(inst_sel_vector_t * isv)
methods.description: Unwatches all selectors currently being watched within the vector.

methods.name: void INST_SEL_VECTOR_Fill(inst_sel_vector_t * isv,int num_entries,unsigned short permission_bitmask)
methods.description: Fills the vector with a specified number of entries, each initialized with wildcard permissions.

methods.name: void INST_SEL_VECTOR_Add(inst_sel_vector_t * isv,inst_sel_t * sel)
methods.description: Adds a new selector to the vector, reallocating internal storage.

methods.name: void INST_SEL_VECTOR_Remove(inst_sel_vector_t * isv,int index,bool destroy_entries)
methods.description: Removes a selector at a specified index, optionally freeing its memory.

methods.name: int INST_SEL_VECTOR_Find(inst_sel_vector_t * isv,inst_sel_t * sel)
methods.description: Finds the index of a given selector within the vector.

methods.name: unsigned short INST_SEL_VECTOR_GetPermissionForInstance(inst_sel_vector_t * isv,dm_instances_t * inst,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Determines the effective permission bitmask for a specific set of instance numbers based on the selectors in the vector.

methods.name: bool DoPermissionInstancesMatch(inst_sel_t * sel,dm_instances_t * inst,bool * again,unsigned flags)
